limitations: Short-cycle protocol/process evidence does not prove visible presentation or long-session stability.
EOF used near-end seek to 124 seconds and explicit Play; stdin remained open.
Preliminary probe paused near startup; seek retained pause. Later successful cycles do not resolve intermittent buffering.
Silent MRP-only loss is bounded by the next 30-second heartbeat plus the default 5-second request deadline; actual interruption not tested.
Receiver-remote stop returned home and automatically cleaned up but classified connection_lost/exit 1; normal stop classification is unresolved.
Sleep setup emitted repeated loading/playing URL states before the user slept the receiver; buffering remains unresolved.
